kind: external-agent workspace, role and workflow orchestrator

runtime.execution: CLI and daemon supervise role-specific external harness processes in tmux/worktrees; hooks, detached pollers, async notifications.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns town/rigs/worktree/Beads and role infrastructure; external harness owns provider requests, coding tools and compaction.

summary: Gas Town coordinates persistent work and ephemeral external sessions through role-specific automation, formulas, hooks, mail, nudges, handoff and escalation.

inspection.scope: Selected source excerpts trace exposed entry/loop/request/action/result/state boundaries and relevant capability mechanisms; listed tests are read as source only.
inspection.limits: No acquired code executed, dependencies installed or live providers invoked. Claims concern this pinned snapshot; untraced catalog tools and dependency internals are not inferred.

actions.name: StartSession / StopSession
actions.lifecycle: tmux external process; C-c wait then kill
actions.authority: configured command/env; runtime-specific approval bypass presets

actions.name: gt sling <bead-or-formula> [target]
actions.output: hooked base bead and attached workflow wisp
actions.lifecycle: durable assignment before external work completion; rollback on partial spawn failures
actions.authority: operator or model shell; force can discard old molecules

actions.name: gt mol step done <step-id>
actions.lifecycle: reads durable readiness; continuation restarts agent; fan-out notices need manual/other-agent work
actions.authority: agent declares completion; not independently verified task correctness

actions.name: gt mail send / Router.Send
actions.lifecycle: notification async best-effort; WaitPendingNotifications fences goroutine lifetime only
actions.authority: configured address routing/backend; no proof of model reception

actions.name: AcknowledgeDeliveryBead
actions.lifecycle: multiwrite ack-last ordering and retry timestamp reuse
actions.authority: recipient/caller claims receipt; not semantic completion

actions.name: gt nudge <target> --mode wait-idle|queue|immediate
actions.lifecycle: prompt detection, cooperative hook/poller; timeout watchers; immediate fallback if queue fails
actions.authority: caller force overrides DND; receipt is not model result

actions.name: gt handoff --auto / --cycle
actions.lifecycle: auto can continue after mail failure; cycle requires persistence then native continue/respawn
actions.authority: child supplies context/compaction; restart can kill active work

actions.name: gt seance [--talk ID] [-p prompt]
actions.input: previous native session ID/prefix, optional question
actions.output: one-shot answer stdio or interactive child chat
actions.authority: new external model request authority; no context repair in current session implied

actions.name: gt escalate / ack / close / stale
actions.lifecycle: dedup+severity mail; ack/close and stale handling; notification status can overclaim
actions.authority: model/operator may report blocker; no full state snapshot captured

actions.name: gt done
actions.lifecycle: retirement only when durable handoff succeeds; source helper guards push/MR/local strategy
actions.authority: worker and configured merge workflow; not refit

actions.name: gt feed
actions.lifecycle: live activity monitor, polling and dashboard actions
actions.authority: documented exposed monitor; full rendering branch not traced

actions.name: Daemon.Run
actions.lifecycle: signal/timer loops; operational accessor rereads disk
actions.authority: owns town infrastructure and lifecycle, not consumer-only fabric

filesystem.detail: Town rigs/worktree/hooks and per-agent workdir/settings; actual coding tools delegated external harness.

processes.detail: tmux startup/health/kill, detached nudge poller and predecessor subprocess.

code_actions.detail: Formula TOML and launch-command composition orchestrate external work; no traced model program VM for native tool composition.

persistent_kernel.detail: Inspected role controller supplies external agent processes rather than persistent language interpreter.

standing_database.detail: Beads/Dolt work/mail/identity ledger accessible through CLI; town owns/routs infrastructure, not general shared computation consumer.

workflow_programming.detail: Real formula attachment and readiness/step completion; fan-out handler marks ready work and prints goroutine notices, then restarts first step. Other steps need separate agents/manual execution.

multi_model.detail: Runtime presets and per-role/override commands can launch distinct agent/model harnesses; no own provider sampling or model switching protocol inferred.

live_collaboration.detail: Concurrent external roles communicate with persistent mail, channels/groups and nudges; asynchronous delivery acknowledgment distinct from answered conversation.

concurrent_work.detail: Many external roles/pollers can coexist; specific molecule parallel path does not perform parallel tasks despite comments.

steering_interrupt.detail: DND-aware nudge and queued hooks/poller; wait-idle can fall back to immediate input when queue fails. C-c followed by kill is process stop, not provider quiescence acknowledgment.

turn_redefinition.detail: Config/presets/hooks/continuation prompts/formula work structure external harness turns; no inspected programmable inner model step.

compaction.detail: PreCompact auto/cycle packages state and native --continue succession; underlying agent does actual compaction. Auto mode can write marker despite failed mail.

context_repair.detail: Bounded handoff state and predecessor fork/resume query can recover information; no traced original-to-current context restoration API.

original_audit.detail: Operational timestamp JSONL plus optional Claude native transcript watcher. Missing workspace drops events; callers ignore errors; no fsync or universal original model/tool I/O capture. Handoff clears terminal scrollback.

audit_query.detail: Feed time/rig/visibility and Beads/convoy monitor plus predecessor discovery/query; inspected entry contract not full query/renderer implementation.

hot_change.detail: Operational accessors reread config, heartbeat reset adopts next interval; launch presets applied when starting/restarting. No default affected-turn/workflow activation fence traced.

rebuild_continuity.detail: Persist-before-cycle context mail and external --continue respawn, with kill semantics; no compilation/outpost transfer or verified active program/provider request emptiness.

remote_services.detail: Town can stream optional conversation logs to external endpoint; owns town database/lifecycle rather than merely consumes externally governed fabric. Federation documented but internals not traced.

self_improvement.detail: Inspected formula/config/role mechanisms permit composition; no governed model autoresearch/executable refit loop established.

complaints.detail: Native severity escalation captures reason/source/related bead/fingerprint and tracks ack/close; does not capture full agent state into external complaint DB. RuntimeNotified can mean async attempted, not observed.

authority.detail: Model/operator CLI access and powerful runtime defaults; built-in Claude/Gemini bypass routine approvals. Force nudge and molecule replacement remain caller powers.

evaluation.detail: Read tests check restart-command strings, label partial-write semantics and formula readiness. No executed model, tmux successor or actual parallel task oracle.

time_order.detail: Ack-last metadata ordering/retry identity, timer heartbeat and separate async notification; event RFC3339 timestamp not global monotonic sequence or causality.

evidence.claim: Role-based town/worktree orchestration around external coding harnesses; advertised workflows, monitoring and federation.
Start resolves agent config, provisions settings and constructs command/env before tmux startup.
Startup verifies runtime health and optionally tails Claude conversation to remote logging; external provider loop remains separate.
Graceful stop sends C-c then ultimately kills session process tree.
Built-in Claude/Gemini launch flags bypass routine permissions; resume/hooks/fork capabilities are runtime-specific.
Mail routing selects list/queue/announce/channel/group or single recipient.
Single message validates and persists via bd; notification scheduled asynchronously and error ignored; ephemeral messages may not sync Git.
Idle notification submits terminal nudge or queues cooperative boundary delivery; notified count includes queue receipt.
Delivery acknowledgment writes recipient/time before final ack label and removes pending after ack; retries reuse sole matching timestamp.
Default wait-idle checks prompt support; queues and starts non-Claude poller; queue failure can degrade to immediate terminal send; lost session returns error.
Detached nudge-poller has configured poll/idle intervals, PID tracking and process Release; PID write failure leaves untracked process.
Sling defaults bare polecat work to formula, guards existing attachment, allows force burning, instantiates then stores base-bead/molecule relationship.
TOML parsing validates workflow/convoy/expansion/aspect types and references; declarative program rather than model-turn interpreter.
Step done closes durable step then finds readiness and returns/dispatches continue/parallel/done/blocked.
Continuation respawns pane; fan-out only marks steps in progress, prints notices in goroutines and continues first; no actual parallel work execution.
Handoff --auto saves state, --cycle saves and replaces session; hook wiring delegates underlying model compaction.
Auto mode collects bounded state, mail failure only warns and marker is written anyway.
Cycle requires mail persistence before event/restart, constructs --continue prompt, clears scrollback and respawns pane; no executable rebuild fence.
Self succession relies on respawn-pane kill semantics so handoff command survives to issue restart; no active provider/tool emptiness test.
Collected continuity data combines Git, hook, bounded inbox and work views with failed subprocesses omitted.
Seance resolves predecessor, temporarily links native session, launches external --fork-session --resume with one-shot or interactive stdio; clears nested-session guard.
Exposed severity-routed escalation command with ack/close/stale and fingerprint.
Creates deduplicated tracked escalation fields and routed mail; RuntimeNotified=true is set after asynchronous Router.Send and overstates observed notification.
Rigs and operational config reread from disk by accessor.
Daemon signal dispatch processes lifecycle or tracker reload; other signal shuts down.
Heartbeat interval is reread operational config after tick; no affected-agent turn fence.
Timestamped orchestration JSONL has audit/feed visibility and cross-process flock; absent workspace silently drops; writer returns errors without fsync; callers often ignore.
Opt-in Claude transcript watcher chooses newest eligible native file by time and tails across session replacement; not universal provider audit.
Exposed feed combines event file, Beads and convoy views; time/rig filters, problems/attach/nudge/handoff documented contract.
Temporary settings/env test asserts continue flag/custom prompt in constructed restart command; does not spawn real successor.
Pure delivery-label test keeps partial acknowledgments pending until terminal ack label.
Parser/readiness test verifies expected formula dependency and sequential choice; does not execute parallel work.
Done completion/defer/escalate command submits branch to merge queue and retires after durable handoff; underlying coding work external.
Retirement withheld on push/MR failure or local merge strategy.

tests.oracle: Temp filesystem/settings/env assert --continue and custom prompt in string; does not observe successor context.
Pure label parser keeps partial ack pending and exposes recipient/time after final ack; no real crash during bd writes.
Reads template, asserts dependency and selected next sequential step; not real parallel execution.

strengths: Persist-before-cycle refusal preserves continuity source when mail fails.
Acknowledgment labels separate partial state from terminal receipt.
Native predecessor fork/resume offers a concrete context recovery experiment.
limits: Molecule fan-out handler supplies readiness and notices, not execution of parallel work.
Escalation RuntimeNotified status can overclaim asynchronous best-effort mail notification.
Town succession kills/respawns external harness rather than performing compile refit; audit is selective and runtime-dependent.
arconaut_questions: How can Arconaut package predecessor access as inspectable context repair without opaque fork side effects?
Which mailbox/model-consumption statuses should be distinct and causally linked?
Can executable continuity be proved independently of terminal readiness and workflow status labels?
